name: Specialty billing/RCM for independent pediatric therapy clinics (SLP/OT/PT) billing Illinois Medicaid MCOs + commercial — Cook/DuPage/Lake
summary: Outsourced claims, eligibility/authorization tracking, denial and appeal work, payment posting and patient statements for 3-10-clinician pediatric speech/occupational/physical therapy clinics in Chicagoland whose payer mix includes the five HealthChoice Illinois MCOs plus BCBSIL and other commercial plans. Opening trigger: CPT 92507 is deleted on 1 Jan 2027 and replaced by ten time-based SLP treatment codes. Fee: ~6.5% of commercial collections plus a flat per-claim fee on Medicaid claims (42 CFR 447.10). Customers = clinics; billers are capacity-triggered staff.
evidence_notes: Published fee levels: TheraThink (mental health) 6.5-8% of allowed amount, no setup, $35/mo clearinghouse pass-through, credentialing $120-260 per application [B, DD-S021]; Carepatron managed billing 3.9% + $79-99/provider/mo + $0.25/claim [B, DD-S022]; vendor-stated market ranges 4-9% of collections and $1-5 per claim [D, DD-S023]; SPRY pediatric RCM 4-6% [D, DD-S024].

Illinois Medicaid FFS rates (practitioner fee schedule eff. 10/1/2026): 92507 $50.81 state max; 92523 eval $151.80; 97530 $23.99/unit; 97110 $19.41/unit; 2.7% reduction applies to non-excluded provider types [A, DD-S027]. MCO rates and commercial (BCBSIL) rates MISSING.

Five HealthChoice Illinois plans: Aetna Better Health, Blue Cross Community Health Plans, Molina, Meridian (incl. YouthCare), CountyCare (Cook only) [A, DD-S026] - each with its own portal, authorization and denial rules.
CPT 92507 deleted 1 Jan 2027; ten time-based codes (base 30 min + 15-min add-ons) replace it; Medicare-only pediatric code proposed; Medicaid/commercial implementation not addressed [C, DD-S028].
Platform competition: CentralReach BillMax (ABA) [C6-S037]; SimplePractice self-serve claim tools + paid Claim Assistant [B, DD-S025]; Carepatron and SPRY bundle RCM with EHR [B/D, DD-S022, DD-S024].

Biller cost: Illinois medical records specialist median $56,440 (Chicago $57,970) [C, C6-S027] x1.2 = ~$68k loaded. Capacity 4 clinics (~20 clinicians) per biller with AI-assisted scrubbing is an assumption (E).
Clinic size, visit volume, payer mix and blended collection per visit are E (no Illinois data). Founder draw $4,000/month from month 13 (cross-model convention).

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: No Illinois billing licence identified (Stage C, not re-verified); HIPAA policies, BAA, E&O/cyber, clearinghouse account, hire experienced biller.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: 1-3 months; vendor controls cash flow so trust barrier is high (Stage A/C).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified owner conversations/month from NPPES-identified clinics, ISHA/IOTA networks, EHR partner listings, 92507-transition content.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Free A/R aging + denial audit -> proposal.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: No track record; high perceived switching risk.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Sticky once onboarded; losses from clinic sale/PE roll-up, EHR-bundled billing, errors. No data.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Base clinic 5 clinicians x 1,200 billed visits/yr x ~$70 blended (Medicaid 92507 $49.44 after 2.7% cut, A DD-S027; commercial assumed $85-100, E) = ~$420k collections x ~6.8% blended fee (6.5% commercial per DD-S021 range + $5/claim Medicaid).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Credentialing applications ($120-260 each, DD-S021) + aged-A/R recovery project.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Clearinghouse ~$120/mo per tax ID (Claim.MD Unlimited, DD-S029) + statements/postage ~$40; biller labor is in staff.
drivers.dso_days__source: Invoice early next month on prior-month collections, net 15 or auto-debit.

staff.notes: IL median $56,440 x1.2 (C6-S027); hired at first client because the founder has no billing track record.
